notes.title: Scrapnaut Update 1.6.1
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38261023/2084b2387f2dcfd396d11c954d76316dc2e66f58.png[/img]

[h3]Greetings Scrapnauts![/h3]

The 1.6.1 update is now ready for download.

[h3]Here is the list of changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Chat Command System[/b]
Many people have asked me about cheats or creative mode for the game, so in version 1.6.1 I added an in-game command system.

More information is available here -> [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1323900/discussions/0/3192493998737682443/]Link[/url]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38261023/12bb65bd2760d33c5583432ca82870af6ea4f99e.png[/img]
[*][b]Added new animations[/b]

[*][b]Migration to a new engine version[/b]

[*][b]New game loading system[/b]
In the future, this will allow me to add new worlds to the game and more quests.

[*][b]Confirmation box[/b]
Added confirmation box for save system.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38261023/02aa085612a2339f8a7cbe9dbf0e76e3e0955023.png[/img]
[*][b]Added ping display in coop mode[/b]

[*][b]Implemented server error display in case of disconnection[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38261023/68df10e8663197c2458301bef9125e7e355066e1.png[/img]

[*][b]Added Permadeath Mode[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38261023/add39cc6375ae7b3ce1926d77154d027a22ef38e.png[/img]
[*][b]Added Extra Base Management Mode[/b]
In this mode you must use multiple bases. Staying in one base for too long will result in constant enemy attacks.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38261023/df40211bd8d2c6f10b5ec11d4593db02ce39f705.png[/img]
[*][b]Added an achievement to Permadeath Mode[/b]

[*][b]Fixed a bug with the "run to exit" button[/b]

[*][b]Updated languages[/b]

[*][b]Added new structures to build (Raid Generators)[/b]
These structures are used to generate raids at any time.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38261023/586e1714e13cb67542ad2a442cd5ee1cf43c9de7.png[/img]
[/list]

Best Regards,
Bart

notes.title: Scrapnaut Launch Update is Available Now!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38261023/f8ad1626c18e3fa81f686183675386e5e5e30bb4.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38261023/a16a0b92ad09a104c230df94a32a8c696c29e745.png[/img]
[h2]Greetings Scrapnauts! [/h2]

After 6 months of early access we have finished the full version of Scrapnaut. During this period we added some important updates like multiplayer and full controller support. Today we would like to share with you a new update with the second chapter!

The game is visible as a full release, but don't worry. [b]We will keep supporting Scrapnaut and another big update will be added soon! [/b]

[h3]What can you expect?[/h3]
The most important changes in this update are listed below.

Kind Regards,
Scrapnaut Team

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38261023/d5f221ef9160f695f9913bc5b05c97046ee70c80.png[/img]

You can continue your journey. Your old game save will be compatible and you don't have to start from scratch. The second part of the game will allow you to complete a portal quest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38261023/0f48ac4c5ca0ec13f2c87c1fdace485e6435c77f.png[/img]

You can also find some secret locations in previous biomes :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38261023/a73a35b5c7b9bec48cbb6dd3abf4cf1baed18e2a.png[/img]

A new raw material has been added to the game. It's quartz. You can use it to create light bulbs, which are now a basic requirement for all kinds of lighting.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38261023/0e2f2770f3c3bbc72c88454742eccf6b653c81d2.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38261023/832bcfc2d7ad9acab2fbc61dddc2bec7642f23c8.png[/img]

You can also create different types of lantern and put it on your backpack.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38261023/c75baf97d3ad2834212c66c1081a52e7ae7bf009.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38261023/156f4898b6bbdb9a7867335b02ac7f11b5cdf4f7.png[/img]

During your adventure, you will be able to find additional blueprints that will allow you to build various useful items and decorations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38261023/c2d0d586ae22b481529f42c0ebed96ffc4996638.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38261023/62f74b756a0284b3d9f65fe7de0a7370db4e7791.png[/img]

Now you can build a shredder and a recycling machine (Blueprint required).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38261023/e126cf0cc412a89948a0686d19db420595816de8.png[/img]

We have added a potato machine to the third biome! You can use their seeds and transfer the production to other biomes :D

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38261023/c8a7624c16db2d5a30d649d376e25589786cc7d9.png[/img]

Other new objects are only available from blueprints.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38261023/22db039d5534f22301a207fc3b3d16a6dcb5c718.png[/img]

In the next update, we added a few rooms with puzzles. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38261023/a99fc7b8a5ee3e9c2e5e7a08313d3662c114f914.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38261023/158a0e2a591f34d57e657562d971f5cb2170b380.png[/img]

If you have any problems you can join our discord server. We will help you :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38261023/79d238f2aebdae59d60211796420aa39f12146ce.png[/img]

If you will be continuing your adventure with the tutorial disabled then this information is for you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38261023/7927b6dc0ba117854fa4e8fce2318995ec625f85.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38261023/8f14c99eb6fa96eb29f82337d78601542e7a9845.png[/img]

Your new opponents will be much stronger! Each new boss will also shoot at you, so work on your equipment!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38261023/ebd86e19713108c7792ea3cc691076b647084a8f.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38261023/6cc77a4435e99321de7461e371e125c2195184ac.png[/img]

Here's a list with [b]upcoming updates[/b]:
[list]
[*]New Game Modes!
[*]Linux Support
[*]Additional control mode (Click to move)
[/list]You can also expect some big updates.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38261023/a16a0b92ad09a104c230df94a32a8c696c29e745.png[/img]
[url=https://www.facebook.com/Scrapnaut-104039038344713/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38261023/5a13ed409bf4ce66c008e8c4247506c57ba46203.png[/img][/url]

[url=https://www.facebook.com/groups/2325485520928583][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38261023/639888523876ca155bc8b4f426bf544faba69887.png[/img][/url]

[url=http://discord.gg/B48g4PD][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38261023/ad677f84b833ff67a3a5744ac7bcfe339065f09c.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Update 1.1 Online co-op mode!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38261023/387cb6f3d5b251d6ebafe23ff4e835993d4aa6fe.png[/img]

[h2]Greetings Scrapnauts![/h2]

The co-op update is now available!
Here is a list of the most important information:
[list]
[*]Each player must have the same version of the game and server region to join your room.
[*]You will be able to change the game mode to online cooperation, even if you start in single player mode.
[*]You can change the server region in the game settings.
[*]The co-op mode is compatible with previous saves.
[*]Blue books (management) sync to all players.
[*]Other books are assigned individually for each player.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38261023/dea79e31d3e0b2226a4961080665edc18ce1b38e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38261023/1a94384d92a6e1335f53ad581575a2103c9298b2.png[/img]
The online mode will allow up to 4 players to play together in one world. Your previous saves will work without any problem.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38261023/549c95a89cc542a8d69f53bb01089f42c8f7f6d2.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38261023/3567d303e24990cdad21c0e94036f990ca59aa66.png[/img]
Your friends who join during the game will appear in a special shelter next to first base.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38261023/c21343361ab3059e5b8f271a7f24422866584cb7.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38261023/9e72d11f5660aafeef98d23af7338727777c671c.png[/img]
In cooperation, permanent death has been replaced with a respawn mechanism. When you die, you can come back for your equipment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38261023/4108dcdd491686e206229c8ab9d6556d02c180be.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38261023/a7a8de24cb38fe0f7e3117731b4c2509a52c90a3.png[/img]
You can change your respawn point after sleeping in a bed or tent.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38261023/9145277ce41cb4ca8cabe561ddbcf3e51296a521.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38261023/d9676f4baee94ef703935737adca80dd6b2979c7.png[/img]
Press the T key to open the chat window. The owner can also use this menu to kick players off the server.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38261023/98f3bc1236b982ab0b406d198b84cade26b48b2e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38261023/5d82e43d95ecca2d2bf62740983633292d7f4221.png[/img]
In the public list you will find rooms available to everyone in the same region.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38261023/e64a7af1dfa739dbd4aedd180611789c9d828246.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38261023/17e12f50cddca26adcef64dd1e28c187209a6fdb.png[/img]
You can also create a password-protected private room.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38261023/a233e36d4d0d4d7a0575f3d42f76da4db0482262.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38261023/4dad9cf3205e96f9fd9930b343edbde3c02a8ad8.png[/img]
You can also display rooms created by people on your friends list. Make sure you have the same server region in your settings!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38261023/d2983e80cc3450d7dfdfc44a4741fcf90ae5a854.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38261023/dea79e31d3e0b2226a4961080665edc18ce1b38e.png[/img]
